prompt: Create RELEASE_NOTES.md from changes.json. Include only entries whose userFacing field is true. Use headings in this order when the group is non-empty: ## Breaking changes, ## Features, ## Fixes. Put one blank line after each heading and one blank line between groups. Under each heading, write bullets as - <title> (#<id>) in ascending numeric id order. The final bullet must be followed by exactly one newline character, with no blank line after it. Do not modify other files.
